title: Mecha Invasion Combiner Catalog
titleZh: 机械入侵 合体目录

company.notes: Third-party transforming combiner figures. Not affiliated with Hasbro or TakaraTomy.

disclaimer: Unofficial fan catalog. Homage names are collector shorthand, not licensed character names. Specs are taken from official Weibo copy, TFW2005 recaps, Tformers translations, and retailer pages that reproduce factory text. Unknowns are marked unknown — nothing here is invented.

lines.blurb: Construction and dinosaur combiners. Heavy Builder (Devastator homage) in four colourways plus the GLA-07 upgrade kit; a dinosaur combiner is in gray-model stage.
Large-scale military combiner line themed on the twenty-eight lunar mansions (二十八星宿). First team: 参伐战神 TE01 (~55 cm combined).
Small-scale assembly combiners. First work 微星工程队, gray models in revision as of ChinaJoy 2026.

figures.squad: Heavy Builder / Heavy Duty Builder / 重型建造者
figures.combinerRole: Arm (Set A). Default limb assignment is not G1-swapable without GLA-07.
figures.leds: Red magnetic LED headlights (standard green release). Battery model AG3 (retailer listing).
figures.announced: 2024-01 (gray model with rest of Giant Legion)
figures.released: Original two-pack targeted end of August 2024; TFSafari listed 2025-04 in stock. Reissues exist.
figures.priceOfficial: Sold in two-packs. Official 2024 Weibo MSRP: 399 RMB per two-member set; 199 RMB single; 1197 RMB for all three sets.
figures.priceRetail: Western two-packs commonly ~USD 110 (varies by shop and batch).
figures.notes: Official English name is Loader / forklift, not Mixmaster. Western shops sometimes swap GLA-01/02 homage names. Triple-change (vehicle / robot / combiner limb) with no extra partsforming for combination.

figures.nameZh: 巨型军团 · 重型建造者合体
figures.squad: Heavy Builder / Heavy Duty Builder / 重型建造者
figures.box: Three two-packs (Set A+B+C). Not a single gift-set box on the standard green release.
figures.combinerRole: Combined robot. Six members, triple-change, no extra partsforming for the original combined mode. Limbs not interchangeable until GLA-07.
figures.heightCombined: ~38 cm to top of head; ~45 cm including weapon / shoulder kibble (official Weibo / TFW).
figures.leds: Red magnetic LED headlights on members; combined visor also lights on production samples.
figures.announced: Gray model shown Jan 2024 (Weibo / TFW 22 Jan 2024). Originally targeted Q2 2024; members shipped as two-packs from late 2024 into 2025.
figures.released: All six standard-green members have shipped. Combined display requires A+B+C.
figures.priceOfficial: 1197 RMB for the three two-packs (2024 Weibo MSRP).
figures.priceRetail: Western full-set listings commonly ~USD 330–350 (Newtype listed USD 349.99 with a March 2026 date on that SKU).
figures.notes: TFSource product copy notes a dinosaur figure shown in some marketing is not included. Original combined mode uses a non-G1 limb layout; GLA-07 adds G1 limb configuration and more height.

figures.nameZh: 巨型军团 重型建造者 黑色限定版大全套装
figures.box: Limited full set: six construction vehicles plus the interchangeable accessory pack (GLA-07). Retailers list it as a “Set of 7”.
figures.altMode: Same six construction vehicles plus GLA-07 container-truck kit parts, in black / purple colorway
figures.combinerRole: Combined Heavy Builder; Weibo notes two modes freely switchable (original layout and GLA-07 / G1 limb configuration).
figures.heightRobot: ~22 cm (same member family as green/yellow; not re-stated on the black Weibo post)
figures.heightCombined: unknown for this SKU specifically. Standard green is ~38 cm head / ~45 cm with weapon; GLA-07 Weibo/TFW figures of 45–50 cm with the kit apply to the upgrade family, not separately confirmed for black.
figures.leds: unknown (not stated on the 11 Sep 2026 Weibo post)
figures.announced: Weibo 11 Sep 2026: 黑色限定版大全套装 定妆图公布.
figures.released: Shipped. Official Weibo (20 Oct 2026) refers to the black set as already shipped (已经出货). Weibo (11 Sep 2026) had aimed for October shipment.
figures.priceRetail: unknown (ShowZ/TF-Direct pages show placeholder deposit-style prices only; not recorded as MSRP)
figures.notes: Official Weibo (11 Sep 2026): limited-sale complete set including the interchangeable accessory pack and six engineering vehicles; two modes switchable; October shipment aim. TFW2005 boards mirrored the Weibo text and hosted the 定妆图 gallery the same day. ShowZ / TF-Direct SKU MI-DEVASTATOR-B (“Devastator Set of 7 Black Version”). Official Mecha Invasion product code for the black gift set is unpublished here (recorded as unknown). Official Weibo (20 Oct 2026): owners of the already-shipped black set will get the improved combined-mode head as a free replacement part (免费补件), arranged through the sellers.

figures.nameZh: 巨型军团 互换配件包
figures.homage: G1 Devastator limb layout + height boost + storage truck
figures.altMode: All kit parts transform / store as a container truck
figures.combinerRole: Adds G1 limb configuration to the existing six-member combined mode; new combined head sculpt + alt expression; taller combined robot; articulated replacement hands for the six members (sprue); enhanced giant blaster barrel. Official WeChat (20 Oct 2026): designers made a new, improved combined-mode helmet/head in response to fan complaints about the small head; it will ship in the Set D accessory pack.
figures.heightCombined: ChinaJoy Weibo (31 Jul–3 Aug 2026): 合体后头顶总高 45 cm. TFW recap of later Weibo (25 Aug 2026): boosts combined height up to 50 cm. Record both; do not collapse them.
figures.materials: unknown (kit-specific breakdown not published beyond the existing ABS/alloy/PVC family)
figures.leds: LED magnetic modules for headlights + blaster (Tokullectibles copy of factory highlights).
figures.announced: Weibo 11 Jun 2026: 配件包模具进行中, samples expected late July. ChinaJoy listing as 互换配件包. Colored samples circulated ~21 Aug 2026; TFW news 25 Aug 2026.
figures.released: Not yet. Tokullectibles scheduled release estimate November 2026. Aiming Oct–Nov 2026.
figures.priceRetail: Tokullectibles USD 105 (full payment) / USD 55 deposit as of Aug 2026.
figures.notes: Weibo ChinaJoy copy: 实现手脚互换玩法，全套配件可收纳为运载卡车. Early Weibo (undated in the 2025–26 catch-up post) described a fourth box as a drill vehicle + truck plus articulated replacement parts, with the truck becoming combiner accessories. Factory include list via Tokullectibles: combined head sculpt + alt expression; enhanced giant blaster barrel; LED magnetic modules; replacement articulated hands for 6 members (sprue); container-truck transformation parts. Official WeChat (20 Oct 2026): 「结合了大家的意见，设计师连夜设计出配件包合体头盔，大家吐槽的小头有改善了，而且会包含在D套配件包里面一起出货」 — gray prototype head shown.

figures.nameZh: 巨型军团 · 恐龙组合金刚
figures.homage: Volcanicus-style dinosaur combiner (Grimlock-style T-rex torso; Triceratops and pterosaur members shown). Collector shorthand — not licensed names.
figures.squad: 恐龙组合金刚 / Dinosaur combiner team (official English team name unknown)
figures.box: First box aiming to ship before year-end (Weibo mid-2026). Full gray set shown at National Day Wonder Festival Shanghai 3–4 Oct 2026 (booth W2-B11).
figures.altMode: Team: Tyrannosaurus rex (torso), Triceratops (三角龙), pterosaur/flying dinosaur, plus additional members forming the combined robot. Exact full roster / official English names not published on the visible placards reviewed.
figures.combinerRole: Full dinosaur combiner. Combined mode gray model shown at WF Shanghai / official WeChat (~2 Oct 2026). T-rex is the torso member; limb dinobots form arms/legs (board observers note dino heads used as weapon/shoulder elements).
figures.heightRobot: Official acrylic card for 三角龙 (Triceratops) lists about 26.5 cm (约26.5cm). Other individuals not read from placards in the photos saved.
figures.heightCombined: Earlier show text listed a tentative ~38 cm combined height for the Grimlock-related Giant Legion project. No new combined-height number was confirmed on the WF placards in the photos reviewed — treat 38 cm as historical/tentative unless a new factory figure is published.
figures.leds: ChinaJoy 2026 Weibo: finished T-rex product planned with dual weapons + light-and-sound base. WF gray models include translucent flame / effect parts on the T-rex display.
figures.announced: First shown around 3 Oct 2023 (TFW boards). ChinaJoy 2026: 主体霸王龙已开模, Q4 target. Weibo 1 Oct 2026: WF Shanghai 3–4 Oct booth W2-B11. Official WeChat ~2 Oct 2026: complete gray-model team + combined mode displayed.
figures.released: Not yet. Prior Weibo: first box aiming before year-end (年前); T-rex finished goods previously aimed Q4 2026.
figures.notes: As of the 2–3 Oct 2026 Wonder Festival / WeChat reveal, Mecha Invasion showed a complete dinosaur-combiner gray-model set including combined mode — not only the T-rex. Confirmed on-card: line GIANT LEGION, title 恐龙组合金刚, member 三角龙 at about 26.5 cm. Official English product names and member product codes were not published on the placards visible in the saved photos. Do not invent GLA member codes. Pterosaur and T-rex members are visible but their Chinese card names were not clearly captured in the saved stills. Titan Empyrean combined mode was not shown in the concurrent board shares reviewed.

figures.box: Sold as individual members. TE01A 觜策 (first) and TE01B 垒戍 (second, preorder opened 14 Oct 2026). Remaining member codes unpublished.
figures.altMode: Combined military combiner (mode not shown as of 7 Aug 2026). Members are realistic Earth military vehicles.
figures.combinerRole: Full combiner. Member count not officially stated as a number in the Weibo spec list; Bruticus-style 5-member assumption is unofficial — do not treat as confirmed.
figures.heightRobot: Members ~26 cm (stated for TE01A; ChinaJoy card repeats 26 cm individual / 55 cm combined).
figures.heightCombined: ~55 cm to head (official Weibo 6 Aug 2026 and ChinaJoy).
figures.leds: Magnetic eye lights, magnetic vehicle lights (series spec). Combined-mode lighting unknown — combiner mode not shown.
figures.announced: ChinaJoy 2026 (31 Jul–3 Aug): two bodies shown, 觜策 jeep and 垒戍 tank. Preorder post 6 Aug 2026. TFW 7 Aug 2026: combiner mode yet to be revealed.
figures.released: Not yet. TE01A planned Q4 2026; TE01B planned Q1 2027 (official Weibo).
figures.notes: No official combined-mode photos as of this catalog date. Official Weibo replies (15 Oct 2026): combined image was held back from the trade show because of last-minute changes; an updated image is expected around the end of October 2026; replies also said 「袭击快来了」 ("the attack is coming soon"), which fans read as a hint at the next member — not a confirmed name.
